outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open, with the interior and green dish visible in image and left_ego_image (frames 0–30). After approaching and aligning with the door, the robot raises it from its lowered position to upright against the oven front (frames 58–71, image and left_ego_image). The door remains closed as the robot withdraws through frame 101. No failed attempt or unintended displacement of surrounding objects is visible.
